current_date: June 2024 (cover of joint South & Vale Validation Guide); checklists 'adopted ... on 21 December 2022' per the council's validation page
current_evidence: The council's 'Validation check lists' page still links this June 2024 Validation Guide as 'Validation Guide', together with the per-application-type checklists from 2023-03, 2024-03 and 2024-06. A search for a 2025 or 2026 South & Vale revision found nothing newer.

issues.detail: Nutrient Neutrality statement is applied to South Oxfordshire, under Full planning and as a 'Policy-driven requirement (all application types)'. The joint guide marks 7.31 Nutrient Neutrality as VALE REQUIREMENT ONLY, because it concerns the River Lambourn SAC catchment. It does not apply to South Oxfordshire applications.
issues.evidence: 7.31 Nutrient Neutrality Statement (VALE REQUIREMENT ONLY) - new overnight accommodation within the River Lambourn SAC nutrient catchment

issues.detail: Many tab_items, and some app-type rows (Ecological Survey, Street scene, all 'Submission rules' and 'Drawing standards' items, one nutrient neutrality item), were taken from the superseded 2023-01-31 Validation Guide, not the June 2024 guide that the workbook links. Rows from the two versions are mixed, and in some cases the same item appears from both.

Local items in the June 2024 guide not captured: 7.16 Agricultural, Rural or Occupational Worker Dwelling Justification (new agricultural/forestry/equestrian worker dwellings in open countryside; removal of occupancy conditions, with 12 months' marketing); 7.24 Economic Report (change of use of employment land without replacement, loss of pubs, village shops or community facilities; one-year marketing report); 7.23 Drainage and Water Report (any application with surface water implications, e.g. new dwellings, annexes, extensions needing new drainage, and all majors); 7.37 Sustainable Design Measures Statement (all new development, including conversions, refurbishments and residential extensions).
issues.evidence: Section 7 items 7.16, 7.23, 7.24, 7.37 of the June 2024 Validation Guide

issues.detail: Householder lists only the CIL form, Ecology and the checklist form. The guide also applies these to householder work: 7.37 Sustainable Design Measures Statement (residential extensions); 7.23 Drainage and Water Report (extensions needing new drainage); 7.26 FRA (Flood Zones 2/3); 7.18 Arboricultural Assessment (trees within 15m or protected trees affected); 7.29 Heritage Statement (listed buildings/conservation areas); and the Design and Access Statement where floorspace is 100 sq m+ in a designated area.
issues.evidence: 7.37 'All new development, including conversions, refurbishments and residential extensions'; 7.18 trees within 15m

issues.detail: Listed building consent has 'Photographs' and 'Structural Survey' rows, both drawn from advisory heritage-statement guidance ('photographs and structural surveys can often assist...'). It is missing the actual LBC local requirement, a 7.29 Heritage Statement, which Grokbot placed under Full planning only. About 25 other rows carry the note 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', even though the joint guide and the separate Major/Minor/Outline checklists state the applicable types (e.g. Landscape plan, SCI and S106 HoTs 'all major proposals').
issues.evidence: 7.29 Heritage Statement - required for listed building consent and proposals affecting heritage assets

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts give only an item's definition or heading, not the trigger. Energy/Sustainability Statement runs on into the FRA heading and omits the South-only trigger (new-build residential; C2/HMO 1,000 sq m+; non-residential over 1,000 sq m). The FRA excerpt is just a definition (the actual trigger is Flood Zones 2/3, FZ1 sites of 1ha+, critical drainage areas). Transport Assessment/Travel Plan is a definition only (all majors or significant highway implications). Tree Survey is a definition only (trees within 15m or TPO/CA trees). Affordable Housing is cut off at 'for all Use Class C3 housin' (10+ units or 0.5ha; 5+ in AONB). Planning Statement reads only 'an overarching Planning Statement.'
issues.evidence: 7.25 Energy Statement (SOUTH REQUIREMENT ONLY); 7.26 FRA triggers; 7.15 affordable housing thresholds

issues.detail: Several rows carry text from the wrong item. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' uses the retail sequential test and town-centre impact text from 7.34. 'Habitats Regulations Assessment / SPA mitigation' reuses the 7.20 ecology trigger, and the guide has no separate HRA item. 'Self-build / custom build information' uses the BNG self-build exemption criteria from 7.13. 'Pre-application advice' runs into the 7.24 Economic Report heading.
issues.evidence: 7.34 Retail Impact Assessment text; 7.13 BNG exemptions

issues.detail: Most of the 19 tab_items are process text or boilerplate rather than requirements. Examples: the 21-day/7-day invalid-application process, the validation disputes procedure, GDPR/personal data guidance, 'no individual file size to be greater than 10Mb', 'Accurately described documents ... will significantly assist with validation timings', 'It is a double-check mechanism...', and page-footer fragments such as 'P a g e 8 | 32 Planning Application Validation Requirements'.

The Advertisement consent rows 'Block plan / Site plan' and 'Floor plans / Elevations', and the Lawful development cert rows 'Floor plans' and 'Roof plan', use the national-requirements heading text followed by the generic sentence 'Local List Requirements In addition to the national requirements...'. They are not local requirements and have no trigger.
issues.evidence: Advertisement and CLUED checklist .docx: 'Local List Requirements In addition to the national requirements set out above...'

issues.detail: 'all plans to be submitted as separate single page PDF files' and 'Multiple pages, combined PDF files will not be accepted' each appear two or three times in tab_items. The nutrient neutrality trigger list appears twice, once from the 2023 guide and once from the 2024 guide.

Discharge of conditions is recorded as '(none)', but the council page links a specific checklist (FINAL-Approval-of-Detail-Reserved-by-Condition.pdf) that Grokbot did not read. Works to trees is recorded as '(none)', but the page links an 'Application for Tree Works' document and a Hedgerow removal notice checklist.
issues.evidence: Validation check lists page: 'Applications to approve details reserved by condition' -> .../2022/12/FINAL-Approval-of-Detail-Reserved-by-Condition.pdf

summary: Grokbot's link is the current joint South & Vale Validation Guide (June 2024), still linked by the council. The extraction mixes in the superseded 2023 guide, wrongly applies the Vale-only nutrient neutrality requirement to South Oxfordshire, misses four local items (rural worker dwellings, economic report, drainage and water report, sustainable design statement), and has many definition-only or misattributed triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
